g.text: AZURE HUB AND SPOKE · EXPRESSROUTE WITH VPN BACKUP · ONE REGION
Spoke traffic leaves through the hub firewall, and PaaS stays off the address space

On-prem reaches the hub over ExpressRoute private peering, with a site-to-site VPN as backup. The hub firewall inspects what crosses between spokes. The spoke cluster reaches Storage and SQL Database through private endpoints
IPsec peer for the backup tunnel
from the endpoints to the services
on-prem to the region over ExpressRoute
inside Azure: peering and Private Link
Illustrative topology · hop facts are placeholders, not looked-up values
